articles.summary: Sonida Senior Living, Inc. (“Sonida” or the “Company”) (NYSE: SNDA), a leading owner, operator and investor in senior living communities, announced today that Brandon Ribar, President Chief Executive Officer and Max Levy, Chief Investment Officer, are scheduled to participate in the BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference taking place on Tuesday, September 15 th – Thursday, September 17 th at the Two Bryant Park Pavilion, New York, NY. Management will be available on September 17 th for one-on-one meetings with institutional investors during the conference. To schedule a meeting, please contact your bank representative. About Sonida Dallas-based Sonida Senior Living, Inc., is one of the largest, pure-play owner-operators and investors in U.S. senior living communities, with a focus on independent living, assisted living and memory care communities and services for senior adults.
